infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Overcomers uses your location on the Evangelism map to show where you are, so you can save an outreach area, a visit or a follow-up in the right place.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Overcomers opens the camera when you tap Camera in a chat, so you can take a photo or a short video and send it to the conversation.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Overcomers uses the microphone when you record a voice note or a video in chat, so the people you send it to can hear you.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Overcomers uses motion only to point the compass on the Evangelism map, so the map can turn the way you are facing. It is never recorded or shared.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Overcomers adds a service, meeting or event to your calendar only when you tap Add to calendar.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Overcomers adds a service, meeting or event to your calendar only when you tap Add to calendar.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Overcomers adds a service, meeting or event to your calendar only when you tap Add to calendar.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Overcomers only uses reminders if you ask it to remind you about a service or meeting.
